# Course images

The 14 topic images in `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/` are copied unchanged from
[Google Developer Training's Courses app](https://github.com/google-developer-training/basic-android-kotlin-compose-training-courses/tree/main/app/src/main/res/drawable).

The source project's Apache License 2.0 is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
